description: This file is a JNI header for TensorFlow's Java API, defining native method signatures and JNI interface setup for session management, including allocate, delete, and run functions.

methods.name: Java_org_tensorflow_Session_allocate
methods.description: Allocates a TensorFlow session and returns a handle.

methods.name: Java_org_tensorflow_Session_allocate2
methods.description: Allocates a TensorFlow session with additional parameters, including a string and byte array.

methods.name: Java_org_tensorflow_Session_delete
methods.description: Deletes/frees the TensorFlow session associated with the handle.

methods.name: Java_org_tensorflow_Session_run
methods.description: Runs a session with provided input tensors and returns output data.
